title: The staged dense linear-attention verifier chain is byte-exact above the split threshold and is now the default for the measured file type
purpose: The 2026-09-12 rejection of the batched dense linear-attention chain was bit-exactness only (one BF16 ULP at layer 46 on the retained B3 fixture), which is not the promotion bar. Re-measured on the current dense Q4_K_M path under the eager verifier, the staged chain is byte-exact against the serial-exact teacher at every straddle band, with route counters proving the staged owner ran, so the row-wise blanket rule no longer has a correctness reason to cover this artifact. The admission is now the backend default for the measured file type on gfx1151, with the row-wise c1 route as the registered strict fallback behind an explicit environment rollback.
hardware: AMD Radeon 8060S (gfx1151, Strix Halo), ROCm SDK from /home/lhl/miniforge3/envs/therock
execution_profile: production: bf16 KV, native verify mode, candidate budget 3, full-attention split-K decode at its default 1024-token threshold

eager_straddle_bands.band: 1024/1026 eager cases of the graph-eligible packet (staged)
1024 eager acceptance cases of the graph-eligible packet (row-wise control)

caveats: The admission binds a loader-qualified plain artifact identity and the measured file type stamp (MOSTLY_Q4_K_M); a preset-bound (UD) or unknown-manifest artifact keeps the row-wise strict route.
gfx1100 (W7900) has no measurement in this packet and keeps the row-wise strict route.

The adapter's measured 1,023-token provider window still refuses long-context MTP by default; every long-shape serving row in this packet sets HIPENGINE_MTP2_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=8192, so the 3,530-token rows measure the route with the window raised and not the default refusal.

The promotion is inert on a cycle the cached native target graph serves: the graph replays the whole target step and never calls the dense linear chain. The server's own graph context cap is 1,023 tokens, which is why the long serving rows exercise the eager route; the task packet at 4,096 tokens is graph-eligible in its session configuration and needed an explicit allow_graph=False to bind eager cycle ownership.

Pre-existing and not touched by this change: the cached native target graph is not teacher-exact at cycle ends 1,016-1,022, where it submits zero split-K calls against a required split count of 4 and diverges from the serial-exact teacher by up to 9.27 absolute logit delta, KL 6.16 and top-1 agreement 0.667. The same numbers appear with the admission on and off, so the graph route - not the linear-rows route - owns that divergence, and the eager route is byte-exact at the same cycle ends. Filed for follow-up.
